conversations.question: How do i get an my product certified
conversations.answer:
💡 **उत्तर:**
Foreign manufacturers must apply under the Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS): 1) Appoint an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) residing in India to act as liaison. 2) Submit application on Manakonline with plant layout, factory location, and test setup. 3) BIS officers travel abroad to physically audit the foreign factory. 4) Product samples collected during audit are sent to India for testing in BIS labs. 5) License granted upon satisfactory audit and test results (~6 months process).

conversations.question: How to verify gold hallmark 6-digit HUID code?
conversations.answer:
💡 **उत्तर:**
Consumers can instantly verify gold hallmark purity using the official BIS Care mobile app or online portal: 1) Locate the 6-digit alphanumeric HUID (e.g. AB1234) laser-etched on your gold jewellery. 2) Open the BIS Care App and tap 'Verify HUID'. 3) Enter the 6-digit code. 4) The app will display the registered jeweller name, hallmarking center name, date of hallmarking, article type, and purity grade (e.g., 22K916 or 18K750). If details do not match, file a complaint on the app.

conversations.question: What is IS 4151?
conversations.answer:
📌 **IS 4151:2015: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Motorcyclists Specification**

• **Category:** Safety & Automotive
• **Certification Scheme:** Scheme-I (ISI Mark)
• **Mandatory Status:** 🚨 Mandatory (Quality Control Order in Effect)

**Description:**
Specifies materials, performance, impact absorption, chin strap strength, and peripheral vision requirements for helmets used by two-wheeler riders in India.

**How to Get License (Step-by-Step):**
1. Register manufacturing unit on Manakonline portal (manakonline.in)
2. Select IS 4151:2015 and pay initial application fee of ₹1,000
3. Set up in-house testing facility for impact absorption & penetration resistance
4. Submit factory layout, machinery details, and QC personnel certificates
5. BIS official carries out physical factory inspection & draws samples
6. Samples tested at BIS recognized laboratory
7. Grant of license upon passing test reports (~30-45 days)

**Fees Structure:**
Application fee: ₹1,000 | Inspection fee: ₹7,000/day | Marking fee: ₹15 to ₹25 per 1,000 units | License renewal: ₹1,000 annual

conversations.question: What parameters are tested under IS 10500 drinking water specification?
conversations.answer:
📌 **IS 14543:2016: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) Specification**

• **Category:** Food & Beverages
• **Certification Scheme:** Scheme-I (ISI Mark)
• **Mandatory Status:** 🚨 Mandatory (Quality Control Order in Effect)

**Description:**
Covers physical, chemical, microbiological, radiological, and toxicological parameters for packaged drinking water filled in sealed containers.

**How to Get License (Step-by-Step):**
1. Ensure plant infrastructure has RO, UV sterilization, ozonation & clean filling line
2. Setup fully equipped micro-biology and chemical testing lab at plant
3. Apply online via Manakonline portal under IS 14543
4. BIS audit of plant hygiene, water source report & manufacturing machinery
5. Draw water samples for 30-day comprehensive chemical & microbiological testing
6. License granted upon satisfactory lab test reports

**Fees Structure:**
Application fee: ₹1,000 | Marking fee: ₹87 per 1,000 litres packaged water | Renewal: Annual

conversations.question: What is the difference between ISI mark and CRS?
conversations.answer:
💡 **उत्तर:**
आईएसआई मार्क (स्कीम-I) हेलमेट, पैकेज्ड पानी, स्टील, प्रेशर कुकर और सीमेंट जैसे भौतिक उत्पादों पर लागू होता है। इसके लिए बीआईएस अधिकारियों द्वारा अनिवार्य कारखाने के निरीक्षण और इन-हाउस प्रयोगशाला परीक्षण की आवश्यकता होती है। सीआरएस (स्कीम-II) मुख्य रूप से इलेक्ट्रॉनिक और आईटी उत्पादों (एलईडी बल्ब, लैपटॉप, चार्जर) को कवर करता है। सीआरएस के तहत पंजीकरण से पहले किसी कारखाने के निरीक्षण की आवश्यकता नहीं होती; निर्माता बीआईएस मान्यता प्राप्त लैब में परीक्षण करवाते हैं और ऑनलाइन आर-नंबर प्राप्त करते हैं।

conversations.question: What is the difference between ISI mark and CRS?
conversations.answer:
💡 **Answer:**
The ISI Mark (Scheme-I) applies to physical products like helmets, packaged water, steel, pressure cookers, and cement. It requires a mandatory physical factory inspection by BIS officers and in-house testing facilities before a license is granted. CRS (Compulsory Registration Scheme / Scheme-II) primarily covers electronic and IT products (LED bulbs, laptops, chargers, solar inverters). Under CRS, no factory inspection is required prior to registration; manufacturers test products at a BIS-recognized NABL lab and register online to receive a unique R-Number.

📌 **IS 14543:2016: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) Specification**

• **Category:** Food & Beverages

6. License granted upon satisfactory lab test reports

conversations.answer:
💡 **Answer:**
Consumers can instantly verify gold hallmark purity using the official BIS Care mobile app or online portal: 1) Locate the 6-digit alphanumeric HUID (e.g. AB1234) laser-etched on your gold jewellery. 2) Open the BIS Care App and tap 'Verify HUID'. 3) Enter the 6-digit code. 4) The app will display the registered jeweller name, hallmarking center name, date of hallmarking, article type, and purity grade (e.g., 22K916 or 18K750). If details do not match, file a complaint on the app.
